title: Where does the world's coffee come from?
description: From the coffee belt to your cup: who grows it and where it sails.

shots.title: 184 million bags
shots.say: About 184 million bags of coffee are grown in a year. So where does it all come from?

shots.title: The coffee belt
shots.say: It grows in more than 40 nations, mostly in a band around the equator: the coffee belt.

shots.title: Brazil leads
shots.say: One country leads by far. Brazil grows nearly 40 percent of all the coffee in the world.

shots.title: The top five
shots.say: Next come Vietnam, mostly robusta, then Colombia, Ethiopia and Indonesia.

shots.title: Where coffee began
shots.say: The story of coffee begins in Ethiopia, where ancient coffee forest still grows.

shots.title: Routes north
shots.say: From the belt, the beans sail north. The European Union and the United States are the biggest importers.
